Our skewness is 35, which means our wage data are highly skewed. Our Kurtosis shows that the max outliers are heavily skewing the results. A word of caution is that you may need to talk to the data stewards about the best ways to correct the data. You don’t want to attempt to fix the measurement error and introduce additional problems. Institutional knowledge of the data is very helpful before correcting errors. Let’s fix when race was equal to 4 when there are only 3 categories. We’ll cover this a bit later. We need to be careful with duplicate observations. When working with panel data we will want multiple observations of the same cross-sectional unit, but there should be multiple observations for different time units and not the same time unit.
